item.title: Apple Upgrade launches in the United States
item.content:encoded:
总结:苹果推出全新硬件租赁计划Apple Upgrade，现已在美国正式上线。
Apple Upgrade — a new hardware leasing program — is now available on the Apple Store online, in the Apple Store app, and at Apple Store locations in the United States.

item.title: Apple Maps to power navigation experience for Ford UEV Platform
item.content:encoded:
总结:苹果与福特宣布，Apple Maps将直接集成至福特UEV平台以提供导航体验。
Apple and Ford announced Apple Maps will be integrated directly into Ford’s UEV Platform through the MapKit for Automotive SDK.

item.title: Major League Soccer returns to Apple TV tomorrow
item.content:encoded:
总结:因世界杯休战一个月后，美国职业足球大联盟将于7月16日重返Apple TV。
Following a monthlong break for the FIFA World Cup, Major League Soccer returns to Apple TV tomorrow, July 16.

item.title: Madden NFL 27 Arcade Edition brings gridiron action to Apple Arcade on August 6
item.content:encoded:
总结:《麦登橄榄球27》街机版将于8月6日登陆Apple Arcade，进一步扩充平台热门体育游戏阵容。
Apple Arcade grows its roster of hit sports games with the addition of EA SPORTS Madden NFL 27 and more coming in August.

item.title: Apple and Major League Baseball announce August “Friday Night Baseball” schedule
item.content:encoded:
总结:苹果与美国职业棒球大联盟公布八月“周五夜赛”直播赛程，每周五在Apple TV双赛连播。
Apple and Major League Baseball unveiled the August schedule for “Friday Night Baseball,” the weekly doubleheader streaming every Friday on Apple TV.

item.title: Apple scores record 89 Emmy Award nominations
item.content:encoded:
总结:苹果在第78届黄金时段艾美奖中创下89项提名纪录，涵盖15部节目。
Apple scored a historic 89 nominations across 15 programs for the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards.

item.title: Apple to increase spend with Broadcom to produce billions more U.S. chips
item.content:encoded: Apple announced a new six-year commitment with Broadcom to design and produce custom silicon components and cutting-edge wireless connectivity technologies.

item.title: Apple Creator Studio gets smarter, faster, and more connected
item.content:encoded: Apple today introduced power-packed updates to Apple Creator Studio, a groundbreaking collection of creative apps.

item.title: Apple announces changes to iOS in Brazil
item.content:encoded: Apple today announced changes impacting iOS apps in Brazil that reflect a recent agreement with Brazil’s competition regulator, CADE.

item.title: Apple unveils innovative features and intelligence experiences across services
item.content:encoded: With the 2027 software releases coming this fall, Apple is bringing powerful new features to services users.

item.title: Apple aids app development with new intelligence frameworks and advanced tools
item.content:encoded: Apple today introduced new intelligence capabilities, expanded productivity features in Xcode, and platform improvements.

item.title: Apple unveils next generation of Apple Intelligence, Siri AI, and more
item.content:encoded: Today, Apple previewed its upcoming software releases that will deliver the next generation of Apple Intelligence and introduce Siri AI.

item.title: Apple Intelligence brings powerful AI capabilities into everyday experiences
item.content:encoded: Apple unveils the next generation of Apple Intelligence, integrating powerful AI capabilities into iPhone, iPad, and Mac for more personal and helpful everyday experiences.

item.title: Apple introduces Siri AI, a profoundly more capable and personal assistant
item.content:encoded: Apple introduces Siri AI, a profoundly more capable and personal assistant powered by Apple Intelligence, with personal context, world knowledge, and onscreen awareness.

item.title: Apple previews new child safety features
item.content:encoded: Apple previews new child safety features that give parents greater control over their kids’ content, communication, and device access time.

item.title: Due to DMA, Siri AI delayed in EU for iOS 27 and iPadOS 27
item.content:encoded: Due to the Digital Markets Act, Apple will not be able to ship Siri AI in the European Union with the release of iOS 27 and iPadOS 27.

item.title: Apple expands App Store capabilities to help developers grow and reach new users
item.content:encoded: New App Store capabilities will give developers more flexibility to market their apps, acquire users, and manage subscriptions.

item.title: Apple and Major League Baseball announce July “Friday Night Baseball” schedule
item.content:encoded: Apple and Major League Baseball have announced the July schedule for “Friday Night Baseball” on Apple TV, featuring several marquee matchups.

item.title: Mini Football Legends, Family Feud Pocket, and seven more hits join Apple Arcade
item.content:encoded: Apple Arcade’s award-winning catalog of more than 200 games is adding nine new games, including My Talking Tom 2+ and Coffee Inc 2+.

item.title: App Store ecosystem reaches $1.4 trillion as developers thrive globally
item.content:encoded: Apple today announced the global App Store ecosystem facilitated over $1.4 trillion in developer billings and sales in 2025.
